svg.title: Подъём на тумбу с гирями — положение 1
svg.desc: Original ImageGen hollow contour, vector traced. Kettlebell box step-up. Athlete faces a single stable knee-high step box and holds exactly two kettlebells, one hanging from its top handle in each hand at sides. Left: front working foot planted fully flat on top of box, its knee bent about 90 degrees; trailing foot on floor, hips low. Right: athlete stands tall on TOP of the same box after pushing through the working foot, trailing foot next to it on top, knees and hips extended. Box height and floor remain constant in both phases. Side three-quarter view, complete box and athlete visible. Both weights are bell-shaped with clear loop handles, no dumbbells. Expert biomechanics approval pending.
